title: Refrigerator — one Math Engine, carcass, doors, handles
description:
A parametric REFRIGERATOR on the six-node spine — Geometry → Input Properties → Math Engine → Output Metrics → 2D Render + 3D Render.

THE DOOR IS A PIECE OF THE DEPTH, not a line on the front. The carcass stops short by the door thickness and the doors occupy that slice, so the plan shows the real projection — which is the dimension that decides whether the fridge fits between a counter and a wall.

THREE ARRANGEMENTS, one ternary: a single full-height door, a fridge over a freezer split at the Freezer share, or two side-by-side leaves either side of the centre line. The carcass, the handles and every published figure are the same in all three.

SWING CLEARANCE is published because it is the number that gets a fridge rejected on site: a door needs most of its own width to open, and 0.9 × the leaf is the figure to plan against.

props.name: Semantics
props.value: brushed steel double-door refrigerator, freezer below, recessed handles

params.name: Refrigerator maths
params.expr:
_natL = length
# Host frame — node, segment or space
_e1 = hcat(1, 0)
_np = rows(P)
_isSeg = _np == 2
_isSpace = _np > 2
_edges = _isSpace ? (shift(P, -1) - P) : _e1
_edgeLen = len(_edges)
_longest = max(_edgeLen)
_spaceDir = _isSpace ? row(compress(_edges, eq(_edgeLen, _longest)), 0) : _e1
_segDir = _isSeg ? (row(P, 1) - row(P, 0)) : _e1
_dir = _isSpace ? _spaceDir : (_isSeg ? _segDir : _e1)
_dirLen = len(_dir)
_axisB = _dirLen > 0 ? normalize(_dir) : _e1
_rot = rotation * PI / 180
_crot = cos(_rot)
_srot = sin(_rot)
_bx = sub(_axisB, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_by = sub(_axisB, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_axisU = hcat(_bx * _crot - _by * _srot, _bx * _srot + _by * _crot)
_axisV = (flipSide > 0 ? -1 : 1) * perp(_axisU)
_ux = sub(_axisU, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_uy = sub(_axisU, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_vx = sub(_axisV, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_vy = sub(_axisV, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_Qu = col(P, 0) * _ux + col(P, 1) * _uy
_Qv = col(P, 0) * _vx + col(P, 1) * _vy
_hu0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qu) : 0
_hu1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qu) : 0
_hv0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qv) : 0
_hv1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qv) : 0
_hcu = (_hu0 + _hu1) / 2
_hcv = (_hv0 + _hv1) / 2
_hostL = _hu1 - _hu0
_hostW = _hv1 - _hv0
# Fit to host — one uniform scale, Max never enlarges
_availL = max(0, _hostL - 2 * margin)
_notOff = fitMode != 'Off'
_exact = fitMode == 'Exact'
_sRaw = _natL > 0 ? _availL / _natL : 1
_sFit = (_notOff && _availL > 0) ? (_exact ? _sRaw : min(1, _sRaw)) : 1
scale = max(0.15, min(5, _sFit))
_s = scale
_Ln = length * _s
_Wd = width * _s
_Ht = height * _s
_bodyL = _Ln
_bodyW = _Wd
_u0 = 0 - _Ln / 2
_u1 = _Ln / 2
_v0 = 0 - _Wd / 2
_v1 = _Wd / 2
_dT = min(doorThk * _s, _Wd * 0.25)
_isSingle = doors == 'Single door' ? 1 : 0
_isSbS = doors == 'Side by side' ? 1 : 0
_split = _Ht * max(0.1, min(0.6, freezerRatio))
_du0 = _u0
_du1 = _u1
_dv0 = _v1 - _dT
_dv1 = _v1
_umid = (_u0 + _u1) / 2
_hw = 0.02 * _s
# Anchor — place the footprint by any of the nine box points
_anchorL = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Left-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left'
_anchorR = anchorDir == 'Top-Right' || anchorDir == 'Right-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_anchorT = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Top-Center' || anchorDir == 'Top-Right'
_anchorB = anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_ax = _anchorR - _anchorL
_ay = _anchorB - _anchorT
_hau = _hcu + _ax * max(0, _hostL / 2 - margin)
_hav = _hcv + _ay * max(0, _hostW / 2 - margin)
_cu = _hau - _ax * _bodyL / 2
_cv = _hav - _ay * _bodyW / 2
_CAR = hcat(_u0, _v0, _u1, _v0, _u1, _v1 - _dT, _u0, _v1 - _dT, 0, _Ht, 1)
_D1 = hcat(_du0, _dv0, _du1, _dv0, _du1, _dv1, _du0, _dv1, _split, _Ht, 2)
_D2 = hcat(_du0, _dv0, _du1, _dv0, _du1, _dv1, _du0, _dv1, 0, _split - 0.01 * _s, 2)
_DS = hcat(_du0, _dv0, _du1, _dv0, _du1, _dv1, _du0, _dv1, 0, _Ht, 2)
_DL = hcat(_du0, _dv0, _umid - 0.005 * _s, _dv0, _umid - 0.005 * _s, _dv1, _du0, _dv1, 0, _Ht, 2)
_DRt = hcat(_umid + 0.005 * _s, _dv0, _du1, _dv0, _du1, _dv1, _umid + 0.005 * _s, _dv1, 0, _Ht, 2)
_DOORS = _isSingle > 0 ? _DS : (_isSbS > 0 ? vcat(_DL, _DRt) : vcat(_D1, _D2))
_H1 = hcat(_umid - _hw, _dv1, _umid + _hw, _dv1, _umid + _hw, _dv1 + 0.03 * _s, _umid - _hw, _dv1 + 0.03 * _s, _split + 0.1 * _s, _Ht - 0.15 * _s, 3)
_H2 = hcat(_umid - _hw, _dv1, _umid + _hw, _dv1, _umid + _hw, _dv1 + 0.03 * _s, _umid - _hw, _dv1 + 0.03 * _s, 0.1 * _s, _split - 0.1 * _s, 3)
_HND = showHandles > 0 ? vcat(_H1, _H2) : zeros(0, 11)
Q = vcat(vcat(_CAR, _DOORS), _HND)
# Quad prism — every part is a quad swept from z0 to z1 (6 faces)
_nq = rows(Q)
_r4 = ones(4,1)
_a1 = col(Q,0)
_b1 = col(Q,1)
_a2 = col(Q,2)
_b2 = col(Q,3)
_a3 = col(Q,4)
_b3 = col(Q,5)
_a4 = col(Q,6)
_b4 = col(Q,7)
_qz0 = col(Q,8)
_qz1 = col(Q,9)
_gq = kron(col(Q,10), _r4)
_fq = kron(arange(_nq), _r4) * 6
_q0 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 0, _gq)
_q1 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 1, _gq)
_q2 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a1,_b1,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 2, _gq)
_q3 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 3, _gq)
_q4 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 4, _gq)
_q5 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 5, _gq)
_FL = vcat(_q0,_q1,_q2,_q3,_q4,_q5)
_PL = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_a2,_b2,_a3,_b3,_a4,_b4), 4*_nq, 2), kron(arange(_nq), _r4), _gq)
# Local (u,v,z) -> world, once, for every part at the same time
_U = _cu + col(_FL,0)
_V = _cv + col(_FL,1)
_W = hcat(_U * _ux + _V * _vx, _U * _uy + _V * _vy, col(_FL,2), col(_FL,3), col(_FL,4))
_nw = rows(_W)
_PU = _cu + col(_PL,0)
_PV = _cv + col(_PL,1)
_WP = hcat(_PU * _ux + _PV * _vx, _PU * _uy + _PV * _vy, col(_PL,2), col(_PL,3))
_nwp = rows(_WP)
Carcass3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 1)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
CarcassPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 1)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
Doors3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 2)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
DoorsPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 2)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
Handles3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 3)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
HandlesPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 3)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
# Metrics
overallLength = _Ln
overallWidth = _Wd
overallHeight = _Ht
footprint = _Ln * _Wd
grossVolume = _Ln * _Wd * _Ht * 0.75
freezerLevel = _split
swingClear = _Ln * 0.9
